# MyGrowth

> MyGrowth (MyGrowth: Habit & Life Tracker) is an iOS habit tracker by Sagomak. It turns habits into a hand-drawn heatmap, charts and statistics. All habit data stays on the device: no account, no cloud, no tracking.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6761617617
- Version: 3.0.0 (hand-drawn design: warm paper light mode, soft graphite dark mode)
- Platform: iPhone (iOS)
- Price: free to download; MyGrowth Pro is an optional in-app purchase (monthly, yearly or one-time). Current prices are shown on the App Store.
- Languages: 25
- Studio: Sagomak. Contact: hello@sagomak.com

## Features

- Dashboard with today's habits as cards and a "Becoming" identity goal in a hand-drawn frame
- Grid: a year heatmap per habit, in the habit's own colour
- Charts and statistics: consistency, averages, totals, days on target, best days
- Streaks that follow each habit's schedule, so a planned rest day never breaks them
- Events: places, books, trips and concerts, each category with its own colour, shown as a year picture
- Widgets (Habit Grid, Today) and a timer Live Activity on the Lock Screen
- Timers that keep running when you leave the app; durations shown as h, min and s
- CSV import of past logs and full CSV backup and restore (Pro)

## Privacy

- Habits, logs and notes are stored only on the device (iOS on-device storage).
- No account, no analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising identifiers, no cookies or tracking.
- Purchases are processed by Apple. The app checks purchase status with RevenueCat using a random anonymous ID; RevenueCat receives no habit data.
